container: Mental health challenges in older adults are often overlooked because symptoms may be mistaken for normal aging. Depression and anxiety can follow retirement, bereavement, illness, or reduced independence. Loneliness and social isolation may deepen distress, especially when mobility or hearing problems limit connection. Memory changes can also cause fear and confusion, while stigma may prevent people from seeking help. Families and caregivers should notice changes in sleep, appetite, mood, or daily habits. Compassionate conversation, medical assessment, therapy, social activities, and appropriate treatment can improve wellbeing. Accessible services and respectful support help older people retain dignity.
